title: Powers and duties of the Vice-Chairperson

versions.Latest:
115-W. Powers and duties of the Vice-Chairperson.—

—   The Vice-Chairperson of the 
Taluka Panchayat shall,— 
(a) exercise the powers and perform the functions of the Chairperson when he is 
absent on leave or incapacitated from functioning; and 
(b) in the absence of the Chairperson, preside over the meetings of the Taluka 
Panchayat.
